account_id.description: Chatwoot account ID for application and platform account-scoped endpoints.

api_access_token.description: Chatwoot user or platform-app API access token supplied via env/stdin; never inline.

start_date.description: RFC3339 lower bound for the first incremental sync of conversations, contacts, and messages (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z). Ignored once a cursor has been persisted.
